main.title: Abandon Ship (Eventually)
main.description: Everyone else left three days ago. Time you did too.

stages.text: Get out of the utility room
Restore main power: the reactor needs its fission relay
Take the turbolift up to the bridge
Get off the Marigold: by pod, by distress call, or by flying her home

pest.title: Pest Control
pest.description: A bugrat has nested in the hatch and will not let you past.

stages.text: Deal with the bugrat: drive it off, or bribe it

chip.title: A Chip Off the Old Block
chip.description: The Nexus terminal will trade a secret for a working logic chip.

stages.text: Repair the terminal's broken logic chip
Give the fixed chip to the terminal

remote.title: Citrus Power
remote.description: Bolt can build a remote override for the security droid.

stages.text: Bring Bolt a length of wire and something acidic

fruit.title: Comparable Spirit
fruit.description: The replicator will copy anything you give it. Approximately.

stages.text: Give the replicator a sample to copy
Bring it a proper specimen for 'real science'
